title: Google Global Infrastructure & Network Tiers — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates subsea cable fiber cuts and regional failover: demonstrates dynamic BGP and Andromeda SDN traffic rerouting across redundant transatlantic links.
routing_rationale: Google's software-defined WAN (B4) automatically redirects packets around fiber cuts in milliseconds without dropping established TCP sessions.

nodes.label: Dunant Subsea Cable
nodes.detail: High-capacity 250Tbps subsea cable connecting Virginia to France.

nodes.label: B4 Optical SDN Controller
nodes.detail: Monitors optical signal-to-noise ratio (OSNR); detects physical fiber break instantly.

nodes.label: Grace Hopper Cable
nodes.detail: Redundant subsea fiber connecting New York to United Kingdom and Spain.

nodes.label: Global Andromeda Fabric
nodes.detail: Updates flow labels across all edge switches worldwide in under 15ms.

edges.label: 3. Shift Global Flows to Grace Hopper

steps.title: Optical Break Detection
steps.action: Dunant subsea fiber encounters physical anchor cut; optical transponders drop signal.
steps.why_traversal: Hardware optical monitoring detects breaks in microseconds.

steps.title: SDN Fast Reroute
steps.action: B4 SDN controller reprogrammes ingress edge routers to divert transatlantic flows to Grace Hopper cable.
steps.why_traversal: Pre-computed backup paths enable sub-second failover without route oscillation.

steps.title: Traffic Continuity
steps.action: All established customer TCP sessions continue without reset or dropped connections.
steps.why_traversal: Google private WAN capacity headroom guarantees redundant links absorb 100% load.

scenarios.label: Dual Cable Cut Capacity Throttling
scenarios.root_cause: Simultaneous physical cuts on multiple transatlantic subsea cable systems.
scenarios.diverted_path: B4 SDN prioritizes high-priority user traffic; deprioritizes background backup replication.
scenarios.blast_radius: Batch storage replication between US and EU delayed by several hours.
scenarios.recovery: B4 Quality of Service (QoS) guarantees user customer traffic remains unaffected.
